species.real: The Cyprus mouflon is the national animal of Cyprus, where it appears on coins, stamps and the old Cyprus Airways tail fin.
species.name: Agrino

dex.text: Leaps between pine trunks on a slope you would need a rope for, and looks back at you as if you were the odd one. Its horns curl into a full circle and it is quietly very proud of them.
dex.fact: The agrino, the Cypriot mouflon, is a wild sheep found only on Cyprus, in the forests of the Troodos and Paphos hills. Hunted almost out of existence by the early twentieth century, it has been protected since and now numbers in the thousands. It appears on the island's 1, 2 and 5 cent coins.
